reviews.summary: A live ORCA governance vote creates near-term tokenomics/control uncertainty: it could transfer major community treasuries to the team, cut xORCA fee rewards, and enable strategic token deployment. Ongoing scheduled weekly unlocks add supply-flow risk.
materialRisks: Live vote ends October 10, 2026 at 19:42 UTC; if passed, it transfers ~14.2M ORCA and ~70k SOL community treasuries to team control, changes fee allocation to 10% xORCA / 10% discretionary buybacks / 80% team operations, and dissolves the Council. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281))

The proposal permits Strategic Account ORCA to be used for acquisitions; while the team says consideration would use vesting/performance milestones, timing, target, and execution remain undisclosed during the active vote. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281))

Independent unlock tracking reports ongoing releases of about 324,610 ORCA per week across team, private-sale, and advisory allocations (0.53% of float weekly). ([defillama.com](https://defillama.com/protocol/unlocks/orca))

facts.fact: The official Orca forum shows the tokenholder vote went live October 6, 2026; voting ends October 10 and cooldown ends October 12, 2026. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281))

The active proposal itself identifies concentration of control and reduced xORCA yield as risks. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281))

Phemex delisted its ORCA/USDT spot pair on August 27, 2026; this is venue-specific and not evidence that ORCA-EUR is unavailable. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100471))
